app.name: Haq
app.tagline: The help you are entitled to
app.disclaimer: This app helps you understand schemes. Only the government office can decide your application.
home.intro: Take a photo of your documents. We will read them and tell you which government schemes you can get.
home.step1_help: Aadhaar, ration card, bank passbook, any certificate you have.
home.step2_help: Your details are filled in automatically. Nothing leaves this device.
home.step3_help: In your language, with the exact steps to apply.
upload.title: Add a document
upload.help: Lay the paper flat in good light and fill the frame. A phone photo is fine.
upload.detected_unknown: We could not tell which document this is. Please choose below.
upload.low_confidence: Not sure about this one, please check
upload.privacy: Your Aadhaar number is never saved. We keep only the last 4 digits.
upload.failed: We could not read this photo. Try again in better light, or type the details yourself.
upload.next_best: Add your {doc} to settle {n} more schemes
profile.title: My details
profile.help: These came from your documents. Correct anything that is wrong.
profile.questions_help: These cannot be read from any paper. Answering unlocks more schemes.
schemes.title: What you can claim
schemes.none_yet: Add a document and we will start matching schemes for you.
explain.processing_time: A decision usually takes about {days} days.
explain.assumption: We have assumed the following. Tell us if it is wrong.
step.submit_form: Give in the filled form and take a receipt with a reference number.
step.keep_receipt: Keep the receipt. You will need the number to check progress.
step.track_here: Come back here and add the number so we can remind you.
